LanguageEntry.description: Texts of one language. Several packs may add texts to the same language.

id.description:
Language code: 2 or 3 letters `a-z`, optionally `-` and 2 to 8
characters `a-z`, `0-9` (e.g. `de`, `en`, `pt-br`).

name.description:
Name of the language in itself (e.g. `Deutsch`); required in the
first loaded pack that adds texts to this language.

texts.description:
Texts by localisation key (key: 1 to 128 characters `A-Z`, `a-z`,
`0-9`, `_`, `.`, `-`). Parameters are written as `{name}`.

description: A content file in the folder `lang/` (step 2.6, ADR-031).

$schema.description: Path or URL of the JSON Schema for editors; ignored by the game.

languages.description: Texts of one or more languages.

title: LangFile
